test_title: SSC MTS 2024 Official Paper (Held On: 07 Oct, 2024 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
Read the given statement(s) and conclusions carefully. Assuming that the information given in the statements is true, even if it appears to be at variance with commonly known facts, decide which of the given conclusions logically follow(s) from the statement(s).

Statements:

Some kites are rocks.

All rocks are stones.

Conclusions:

(I) Atleast some kites are stones.

(II) All stones are rocks.
solution:
The least possible Venn diagram for the given statements is as shown below :

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/03462726a51b6243137a26b0b7be51d2c394d454414c76b7a7aa0eebbf0e1599.png] 

Conclusions:

(I) Atleast some kites are stones → Follow (As some kites are rocks and all rocks are stones. As whole rocks comes in stones and has some part common with stones, therefore it is true.)

(II) All stones are rocks → Does not follow (As all rocks are stones. So it is possible but not definite.)

∴ Here, Only conclusion (I) follows.​

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 4".
